synthetic_patterns.method: Welch log-PSD; Gaussian envelope removal; temporal median; residual peak spacing and autocorrelation
synthetic_patterns.research_context: Architecture-linked spectral artifacts studied in Suno/Udio; not a Suno detector
synthetic_patterns.interpretation: Persistent periodic high-frequency structure found; may be compatible with architecture-linked artifacts but is not unique to AI music or Suno.

limitations: Frequency-domain heuristics are not verified AI provenance indicators.
Lossy encoding, mastering, harmonic instruments, and source bandwidth can confound measurements.
Whole-file read may require substantial RAM; no streaming interface.
Cutoff and periodicity thresholds are experimental and not calibrated on real-world corpora.
Suno and other generators cannot be identified reliably from a single spectral test.
interpretation: Origin inconclusive: spectral characteristics do not establish provenance.
